author: N+ Univision
headline: ¿Cuál es la realidad en Minnesota por protestas ante ICE?
news_topic: ICE protests; community conditions; protest dynamics; immigration enforcement
collection_notes: National Spanish-language interview with Centro executive director Xavier Vázquez about conditions in Minnesota during ICE-related protests. Vázquez distinguishes community protest from outside actors he says were involved in violent activity, giving Centro interpretive visibility beyond Minnesota media.
